title: Loop wrap is floor-mod
teaches: With :end loop, a clock at or past :dur wraps by floor-mod on the tick grid. That makes a negative clock land positively inside the cycle, and a clock many cycles later land at the same position as the first cycle.
observe: 4 s is exactly :dur and wraps to beat 0.
5 s is beat 2 of the second cycle.
-1 s wraps to beat 6, not to an error.
100 s is 25 whole cycles, so it wraps to beat 0.
